doc: Task 11d: a container job granted network still has only a loopback (--network=none); the one thing behind it is the job proxy, which refuses a host off its allow-list; a direct connect to a public address fails.

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work;  printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) )\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

argv:
test "$(grep -c : /proc/net/dev)" = 1 && test "$HTTPS_PROXY" = http://127.0.0.1:3128 && ! nc -w 2 1.1.1.1 443 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && r=$(printf 'CONNECT example.com:443 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com:443

' | nc -w 3 127.0.0.1 3128) && test -n "$r" && ! echo "$r" | grep -q ' 200' && echo only-the-proxy
